In addition to publishing the security content for macOS 27, macOS 26.7, and macOS 15.8, Apple has now detailed the fixes included in iOS 27 and iPadOS 27, also released today. Here are the details.

Apple details security content of today’s system updates

Between the official release of its 2027 operating system updates, point updates to previous operating systems, and standalone updates to Safari and Xcode, Apple today rolled out security fixes across dozens of devices.

When it comes to iOS 27 and iPadOS 27, Apple’s security content page lists more than 120 fixes, some of which address vulnerabilities that could allow attackers or malicious apps to execute arbitrary code, gain kernel or root privileges, access sensitive user data, bypass system protections, and more.

Here’s the full security content included in iOS 27 and iPadOS 27:
